svg.title: RB2.1 — 04a Use phase v2: model as index
svg.desc: The usage tab opens on the VCU coloured by its end-of-use verdict, with the state of health and the reuse fraction on the panel. Selecting a part fills the panel with what that part recorded. A thermal lens re-tints the same model by temperature history.
svg.text: REUSE LENS (default) — the recycler decision, on the object
limited by thermal fatigue — min of the mechanisms below
0.767 · 506 g of 660 g · inside the 0.5–0.9 Sc4 yield
floating VCU — coloured by end-of-use verdict
PART SELECTED — the panel becomes that part’s record
Over-temperature failure logged 2025; replaced unit not re-qualified.
the selected part lifts and pulses; the rest dims
THERMAL LENS — same model, re-tinted by temperature history
THERMAL CYCLES BY SWING AMPLITUDE — Coffin-Manson damage
heat ramp: cool board, hot processor
SOH = min(mechanisms), no weights. Material recovery is NOT red — it is the correct outcome for a PCB, not a fault. Red stays reserved (00 s.2.1).
Verdict colours: teal reuse · gold reuse-after-test · tab/inactive material recovery · tip consumable
Heat ramp #f08a3c at the top end needs a heat/high token in 00 s.2, or it reuses gold
Pills re-tint the SAME model; they do not open new screens. Part picking reuses ZonePartInteraction (spec 10).
History pill carries the 15 firmware versions and the 13 service events — the only non-spatial block.
